title: wulfenia lutea
intro: Wulfenia lutea, commonly known as Carinthian wintergreen, is a perennial plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is native to the Alps in Central Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wulfenia lutea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Wulfenia lutea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
